3.9.value: Verdict: CONDITIONAL. STRUCTURAL GAP: a participant-directed 404(c) menu assumes daily pricing and daily participant liquidity; this wrapper deals 4x/year. Direct DIA use requires a bridging structure — CIT sleeve, managed account, or TDF sleeve (cell 3.5). Capacity: 4x per year at 5.0% of aggregate NAV (Investor Shares) — a FUND-level cap; at a 5% plan allocation the plan's position is far inside it unless offers are oversubscribed.

6.4.value: ISSUES SCHEDULE K-1s (partnership taxation): K-1 information provided ~75 days after calendar year-end, and may be delayed. Per dictionary 6.4, K-1s are near-disqualifying operationally in DC plans - participant-level recordkeeping cannot process them. MAJOR complexity red flag; contrast SPRIM which markets 1099-not-K-1 as a selling point.
